findings.title: totalPages calculation is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` computes `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. When `user_count` is a non-zero multiple of `limit` (for example `user_count = 50` and `limit = 50`), this returns `2` instead of `1` (`Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`). As a result, `showingLast` stays false on the last real page, the UI shows `1/2`, and clicking `next` advances `offset` to `user_count` and loads an empty page `2/2`.

findings.title: Admin::GroupsController#create ignores alias_level parameter
findings.body: `Discourse.Group#asJSON` sends `alias_level` when creating a group via `POST /admin/groups`, and the new group form exposes the alias level selector before saving. However, `Admin::GroupsController#create` only assigns `name` and `visible` and never reads `params[:alias_level]`, so any alias level chosen when creating a group is silently discarded and has to be set again in a subsequent update.

findings.title: Adding an existing member to a group raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
findings.body: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, `group.add(user)` (which does `group.users.push(user)`) is called without checking whether the user is already in `group.users`. Because `group_users` has a unique index on `(group_id, user_id)`, adding a username that is already a member of the group will raise an unhandled `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` (500 error) instead of skipping the duplicate or returning a validation error.

findings.title: Unbounded and unvalidated limit/offset in GroupsController#members
findings.body: `GroupsController#members` sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` without clamping them. A caller can pass a negative `limit` or `offset` (causing a Postgres `LIMIT must not be negative` / `OFFSET must not be negative` error and a 500 response) or a huge `limit` to force serialization of the entire user table in one request. Additionally, if `limit` is `0`, the client's `offset / limit` page calculation in `admin-group.js.es6` divides by zero (`NaN`).
